data_source.license: CC0-1.0 independently verified on original dataset
data_source.published_randomization: Mellers et al. (2014) reported Year1 3 training × 4 influence design randomized allocation

research_question: Does randomized access to the distribution of other forecasters' opinions change prospective first-forecast uptake across eligible questions, distinct from accuracy conditional on participating?
unit: all year-1 RANDOMIZED person × eligible opened IFP, including nonrespondents; do not condition on making >=1 forecast

treatment.exclude: Teams, prediction markets, superforecaster tracking from primary analysis
treatment.is_leaderboard: NO; aggregate crowd beliefs access is NOT public rank position

estimand: ITT difference in proportion of IFPs forecast at least once by eligibility window between assigned crowd-belief access and individual control within original randomized training strata. Actual question-view effects are outside identifiable target.
response: First forecast fcast_type=0 within IFP dates; collapse subsequent updates and affirmations per user-IFP; denominator all common IFP opportunities while user was registered and eligible ex ante; NOT number answered, NOT page views
necessary_gate: Verifiable full randomized participant roster including zero-forecast users and registration date/time; do not select on response
Exact assignment protocol and any exclusions/attrition documented
Reliable cohort matching user_id to ctt without retaining direct identifiers
Question open/suspend/close corrected to original %m/%d/%y and %m/%d/%y %H:%M formats
Authorization/ethics/privacy safeguards for processing pseudonymized person-level records despite public CC0 copyright terms
Audit whether original GJP publications already estimate uptake: no novelty claim before adversarial check
strong_rivals: Mellers et al. 2014 original 3x4 effects on Brier accuracy and teaming
Merkle et al. 2015 skill vs question/time
Merkle et al. 2017 MNAR question choice
Hudja et al. 2025 lab finite-horizon negative feedback
Lemus and Marshall 2021 dynamic contest and 2025 contingent prizes
Good Judgment Open official relative Brier and participation-rate scoring
analysis_plan_if_gate_passed: One pooled ITT with training-stratum fixed effects and randomization inference by participant assignment; two-way cluster-robust alternative by person and IFP; predeclare exact common availability risk set; no control for post-treatment participation/accuracy. Follow-up interaction with question horizon would be exploratory, multiplicity controlled in a new prereg.
falsifiers_and_negative_controls: cTT assignment imbalance or missing nonrespondent roster invalidates primary ITT
fake pre-open response count should equal zero and if not flag timestamp/clock mismatch
treatment shuffling within training strata should remove systematic differences (sanity test, not a causal guarantee)
compare accuracy only conditional on forecast as descriptive, not causal
no_field_E_iqt: GJP DDI 'viewtime' is a numeric variable in forecast rows but official label gives no semantics, and does not establish independent views for non-forecasters. A target involving actual exposure E_iqt remains STOP_R5.
scope_and_novelty: A preregistered hypothesis conditional on access and proper data governance, not a proven original finding; near-identical participation outcomes may already be in prior publications.
data_access: No individual forecasts or demographic rows obtained; only CC0 original documentation and DDI variable metadata inspected.
